d:
The Suns defeated the Clippers, 133-110 tonight in Phoenix. Jordan Goodwin contributed a team-high 18 points to go with 6 three pointers and 3 rebounds, with Devin Booker of the Suns adding an additional 17 points (6-14 FG, 2-6 3P) in the game. Rui Hachimura finished with a team-high 13 points along with 5 rebounds for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Suns improve their record to 4-6 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 2-8 for the season.
